description: This file defines utilities related to device management in PyTorch, including context managers for setting device context and functions for handling device-specific tensor creation.

classes.name: DeviceContext
classes.description: A context manager for temporarily setting the current device in PyTorch, managing the mode stack accordingly.

methods.name: _device_constructors()
methods.description: A cached function returning a set of torch functions that serve as device constructors.

methods.name: None __init__(self, device)
methods.description: Initializes the DeviceContext with a specific device, setting it as the current device within the context.

methods.name: __enter__(self)
methods.description: Enters the device context, updating the global CURRENT_DEVICE and managing the mode stack appropriately.

methods.name: __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb)
methods.description: Exits the device context, restoring the previous device and mode stack, ensuring nested contexts are handled properly.

methods.name: __torch_function__(self, func, types, args=(), kwargs=None)
methods.description: Overrides torch functions within the context to ensure device arguments default to the context's device when appropriate.

methods.name: device_decorator(device, func)
methods.description: A decorator to run a function within a specific device context.

methods.name: set_device(device)
methods.description: A function returning a decorator that sets a default device for the wrapped function.
